name: Iridescent Materials, category Digital and 3D Aesthetics. The label was normalized from source descriptions of pearlescent liquid silk and molten glass, so the original label is not retained.
visualIdentity: Explicitly, one dominant surface language is chosen: pearlescent material, flowing silk, or molten glass. Highlights stay coherent, color shifts stay controlled, and the background stays quiet. Rainbow noise and blown-out reflections are excluded.
suitableUses: Explicitly, macro material studies with a quiet background are the strongest fit. The source says a hybrid helps when the material must sell a product or sit in an editorial layout. Inferred: beauty, fashion, fragrance, and product colorway reveals, since the source's examples cite them.
limitations: Explicitly, the single dominant finish must remain, so competing materials are excluded. Avoid rainbow noise, blown-out reflections, chrome or holographic type, and quick cuts. Secondary styles are added only when materials, composition, and movement stay compatible. Simulated appearance is not evidence of physical production.
palette: The palette is a reference-dependent example, not an intrinsic style palette. Suggested tokens: background #F1EDEA, foreground #3F4351, accents #A99DC1, #9FB9B2, and #D3ADA1 (lavender, sage, rose). Gradients are disabled. Task, brand, or approved colors override these, and approved material colors must not be recolored. Two-color contrast checks give foreground on background 8.458:1. Foreground on accent_2 (4.715:1) and accent_3 (4.811:1) meet the normal-text target, while accent_1 (3.882:1) is decorative only. Composited frames must be rechecked.
motionAndInteraction: Explicitly, motion comes from measured flow, folds, rotation, or macro framing, with coherent authored movement and deliberate cuts preserved. Dominant flow uses keyframed deformation or cached simulation. Optional XPBD applies only to flowing silk, with stretch, bending, attachment, and collision constraints, and does not generate iridescence or simulate molten glass. Interaction is unspecified; video must derive all state from seekable time.
audio: Unspecified: the source gives no style-specific audio. The audio direction is topic-driven and fixes no genre, tempo, voice, or mandatory layer. Inferred: silence or restrained ambience suits quiet macro reveals. Any speech must stay intelligible, and audio must be task-authorized and synchronized in the render pipeline.
assetRequirements: Unspecified: no assets are supplied. Stated needs include task-provided exact colors and source artwork, fonts and assets loaded before rendering, and generated or photographed material inputs. Stateful simulations must be baked or cached before rendering. Reference scenes, durations, and aspect ratios are optional examples, not requirements.
combinations: Explicit suggestions: style-020 supplies editorial typography and layout for beauty, fashion, and fragrance campaigns, with type in #3F4351 on #F1EDEA and color shifts coming only from the material. style-096 supplies restrained camera and reveal pacing for product colorways, with one move per shot and one material language per piece. Other combinations are unspecified.
productionApproach: The style renderer is Blender with Python bpy and Cycles, or EEVEE, for materials, lighting, and offline renders; bpy is used through Blender without a separate pip install. The motion engine is Blender keyframes or cached simulation, with XPBD for silk only. HyperFrames is the primary render pipeline for assembly, timing, validation, and export. Remotion is a fallback only when its documented condition is met and the reason is recorded.
